**The mechanics are substantially sound, but I am holding complete-contract implementation approval for one concrete connected-route gap: survival through the required later rest.** The Wound timing and proposed Dispel knowledge/perception route can be approved with the precise amendments below.

I independently verified all **83 pinned Git blobs**, including identities, lengths and SHA256 values; reconciled the two card and five spell extracts; reproduced the 15-file candidate scan; and confirmed the ten-file proposal commit with an empty engine diff. Separate read-only reviews covered Aura/Wound consumers and Dispel. I also inspected the accepted second-rest evidence and its provisioning/debt code. No C#, compilation, gameplay or supplied verifier was executed.

1. **Resolve the later-rest survival gap before runtime approval.**

   The accepted [172800 checkpoint](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/eeb3a803ef736b0827d123d4a88c8620234d1727/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-15-mgt03-cleric-long-rest/implementation/qualification/paths-terminal/ConsoleUninterrupted/long-rest-cadence-172800.ddsave.Player.view.json) retains two hero provisioning shortfalls, an unpaid-debt gain at144000 and a missed-while-indebted gain at172800: **Strain4**.

   Under the unchanged [Rest Debt procedure](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/6d840c4dfce268115904ea0dda6b475450f7be6f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedRestDebt.cs), the230400 deadline adds the fifth point. At259200, the missed indebted Watch itself supplies the sixth—even if that day’s provisioning shortfall is prevented. Continuing the unchanged predecessor history therefore cannot supply the living hero required by the proposed post-rest Guidance witness.

   This is a source-level projection, **not an executed259200 outcome or proof that every lawful route is impossible**. The fresh route needs an earlier concrete plan: actual stock IDs, ownership/access, quantities, paid preparation/intake commands and completion windows, with both actors accounted for across every relevant boundary. Preserve genuine injury, the milestone and all elapsed consequences. Available inventory alone is insufficient evidence.

   Existing public commands may resolve this. **No separate prerequisite module is established yet.** If they cannot, return the exact admission failure before proposing new recovery, supplies or an evidence exception.

2. **Approve the Wound/concentration distinction as a NEW bounded timing ruling.**

   Evaluate Aura at the existing Wound-save event using incoming life, conditions and geometry. Preserve that original contribution through pending resolution and replay. Concentration remains evaluated after complete life settlement; death/incapacity ends concentration before any otherwise-required roll.

   Correct the pending-knockout prose: current code retains pre-damage life while awaiting the decision; it does not commit a displayed zero-HP state. Do not change that behavior to match the draft. Also distinguish **consciousness from Action capability**: standalone Incapacitated does not automatically remove a conscious, perceivable Aura. Explicitly handle self-as-ally; `CanSee(self,self)` currently returns false.

3. **Approve Guidance → Detect → Dispel’s targeting interpretation, with an explicit cohort.**

   The pinned Guidance is nonconcentration and lasts60seconds; Detect therefore does not replace it. Dispel is also nonconcentration.

   Approve the combination of a **current individual Detect outline** and the same caster’s actual historical Guidance provenance establishing generating rank0. Detect itself supplies no rank knowledge. Revalidate the exact observation, effect, original cast, range, perception and line of effect at execution; another controlled actor’s knowledge or an internal effect ID cannot substitute.

   Resolve section6’s scope ambiguity: its stated admission is **own-cast Guidance through that observation/provenance route**. The concluding “existing ordinary spell effects” sentence must not silently admit other targets. Enumerate any intended additions and their knowledge/ending paths before implementation. Preserve the ordinary ending dependencies, distinct appended Dispel cause and old enum identities.

4. **The remaining transaction and history obligations are supported.**

   The exact departure edge, separate completion/award/atomic advancement, preserved current balances, selected Invocation/Aura, earned seventh spell, Invocation payment/vent/activity/recharge and provisional Rite→Radiance→Aura order remain governing. Recharge processing and validation must genuinely use actor **and ability**, preserving existing fear histories. Historical capacities, payments and rests must remain evaluated at their actual revisions.

All1,566 predecessors, authentic95–111 continuations, five-path qualification and genuine operational witnesses remain required. The third-target supplement remains narrowly allocated.

**The immediate next action is the concrete survival/provisioning contract correction and feasibility evidence using existing capabilities, followed by review of that amendment.** Bishop runtime remains held on that issue. The dependency map is unchanged; storage/Support stay on hold, and C#-first development remains active.
